facts.claim: The administrator Simon Maurice renamed the village of N'Gokro Yamoussoukro in honour of Queen Yamoussou; the suffix "kro" means village in Baoulé.

source.title: Kami, N'Gokro et les Boigny : deux villages, un nom et une histoire intimement liée
source.quote: rebaptise le village du nom de Yamoussoukro en hommage à la reine Yamoussou (le suffixe “kro” ajouter signifie village en langue baoulé)

facts.claim: In 1983 Ivory Coast's National Assembly voted to transfer the capital to Yamoussoukro, President Houphouët-Boigny's birthplace, as "a tribute from a grateful nation to a widely respected leader".

source.title: Grateful Ivory Coast turns President's home town into majestic capital
source.quote: a tribute from a grateful nation to a widely respected leader

facts.claim: An academic study says that although Yamoussoukro has been the political and administrative capital since 21 March 1983, it is still awaiting the transfer of state institutions.

source.title: Problématique du transfert effectif de la capitale politique et administrative à Yamoussoukro (Côte d'Ivoire) : 1983-2017
source.author: Kouakou Didié
source.quote: The political and administrative capital of Côte d’Ivoire since March 21, 1983, Yamoussoukro is still awaiting the transfer of state institutions

facts.claim: The same study argues that the effective transfer is hindered by a lack of political will and by a land question.

source.title: Problématique du transfert effectif de la capitale politique et administrative à Yamoussoukro (Côte d'Ivoire) : 1983-2017
source.author: Kouakou Didié
source.quote: le transfert effectif de la capitale à Yamoussoukro est entravé par un manque de volonté politique et par une question foncière

facts.claim: The ten artificial lakes of Yamoussoukro were created in 1966 on the initiative and funding of President Houphouët-Boigny.
